text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 101,258 to 95,091 despite some rebounds; I should assess risk over the whole portfolio, not let a few better months reassure me.","Making no trades avoided impulsive reactions, but I should still review whether my holdings and cash match a deliberate plan rather than defaulting to inaction.","Short-term price moves are random, so I should not chase recent winners or hold losers merely to avoid admitting a mistake."]}
